x: Syd Roberts, maintaining his recent return to form, walked a good race to finish second to Norman Burt (S.W.C.). Once again, our fourth in succession, we won the Scratch Team Race.
This was a proper field day for our lads, who scored a treble with the Scratch and Handicap Team Races, and also first in the Individual Handicap. 1 N.
A few weeks before the Eastleight race, Tommy Green distinguished himself by beating both Norman Burt and Eddie Jury over a distance of 18¾ miles at Poole, Dorset.
